mapper.select: select (doc->'lsite'->'pub')::text pub from tenant_state where tenant_id = #{tid}
select sid, dept, code_hash, pw_hash from learners where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid}
select dept, pw_hash from learners where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid}
mapper.update: update learners set last_login = now() where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid}
mapper.select: select lp::text lp from learner_progress where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid}
select doc::text doc from tenant_state where tenant_id = #{tid}
select kind, login, nickname, student_no, dept, status, minor, idv_ok from learner_accounts where tenant_id = #{tid} and learner_id = cast(#{sid} as uuid)
mapper.insert: insert into learner_progress (tenant_id, sid, lp, bytes) values (#{tid}, #{sid}, cast(#{lp} as jsonb), #{bytes}) on conflict (tenant_id, sid) do update set lp = excluded.lp, bytes = excluded.bytes, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: insert into ai_usage (tenant_id, day, calls) values (#{tid}, cast(#{day} as date), 1) on conflict (tenant_id, day) do update set calls = ai_usage.calls + 1 returning calls
mapper.update: update ai_usage set tin = tin + #{tin}, tout = tout + #{tout} where tenant_id = #{tid} and day = cast(#{day} as date)
mapper.insert: insert into learner_sessions (id, tenant_id, sid, expires_at) values (#{id}, #{tid}, #{sid}, now() + interval '30 days')
mapper.select: select tenant_id, sid, extract(epoch from now() - last_at)::float8 idle from learner_sessions where id = #{id} and expires_at > now()
select doc->'org'->'cpl'->>'idleH' from tenant_state where tenant_id = #{tid} and (doc->'org'->'cpl'->>'on')::boolean
mapper.update: update learner_sessions set last_at = now() where id = #{id}
